# m.crypto.quotes

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

Quotes of crypto pairs: each exchange's best bid and ask, as they change.

Call it from a session `m`, made with `dm.MassiveSession()`:

```python
m.crypto.quotes(symbols, *, on_error=None)
```

- [Methods](README.md#query-methods): `blink()`, `append_only()`, `ring(capacity)`, `last_by(by='Symbol')`
- Read from: WebSocket

[Dataset index](README.md)

## Arguments

A linked argument follows its rule under [shared arguments](README.md#shared-arguments) on the dataset index.

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`symbols`](README.md#symbols) | Crypto pairs, such as `X:BTCUSD`, or `dm.ALL` for every pair. |
| [`on_error`](README.md#on_error) | What a bad symbol or row does in this call (`dm.ErrorPolicy`). |

## Plans

How recent the data is on each of Massive's plans, and how far back its history goes, as Massive's pages state them.

| Plan | Quotes (WebSocket) |
| --- | --- |
| Currencies Basic | Not included |
| Currencies Starter | Real-time |
| Currencies Business | Real-time |

## Columns

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The row's instrument, as Massive's ticker. From WebSocket `pair`: "The crypto pair." |
| `Date` | String | The trading day of the row, as ISO yyyy-MM-dd text: the UTC date of `Timestamp`. |
| `Timestamp` | Instant | The row's event time. From WebSocket `t`: "The Timestamp in Unix MS." |
| `RawSymbol` | String | The symbol exactly as Massive sent it, on a row whose symbol the library can't read. That row's `Symbol` is null. Null on every other row. When the session's `unreadable_symbols` (`MassiveConfig.on_error`) is `dm.OnError.RAISE`, the column is absent, and such a row fails the table unless the call's own `on_error` keeps it. |
| `BidPrice` | double | The bid price. |
| `BidSize` | double | The bid size. |
| `AskPrice` | double | The ask price. |
| `AskSize` | double | The ask size. |
| `Exchange` | long | The crypto exchange ID. See Exchanges (https://massive.com/docs/rest/crypto/market-operations/exchanges) for a list of exchanges and their IDs. |
| `ReceivedTimestamp` | Instant | The timestamp that the tick was received by Massive. |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, by the local clock. Rows that arrive together share it. It isn't Massive's time, and later rows can carry earlier times. |
